title: Spanish Rice Chicken One Pot
seoTitle: Spanish Rice Chicken One Pot | Firefighter Meal
shortDescription: Saffron-style chicken, peppers, peas, and rice
subtitle: Saffron-style chicken, peppers, peas, and rice
description: Chicken thighs, tomatoes, peppers, peas, and seasoned rice simmer in one broad pot until tender.

steps.title: Season chicken
steps.instruction: Season chicken pieces with smoked paprika, garlic, salt, and pepper on a clean tray.

steps.title: Brown chicken
steps.instruction: Brown chicken in a wide heavy pot in batches; crowding will make it pale and watery.

steps.title: Check chicken
steps.instruction: The chicken will finish later, but keep raw utensils away from cooked vegetables and rice.

steps.title: Cook vegetables
steps.instruction: Sauté onion and peppers in the same pot until softened and lightly golden.

steps.title: Toast rice
steps.instruction: Stir rice for 2 minutes in the pan fat until the grains look glossy and separate.

steps.title: Add liquid
steps.instruction: Stir in tomatoes, hot broth, and seasoning, scraping the bottom so nothing sticks.

steps.title: Return chicken
steps.instruction: Nestle chicken into the rice in one layer, leaving some pieces visible for even cooking.

steps.title: Simmer covered
steps.instruction: Cover and cook on low until rice is tender and chicken reaches 165°F in the thickest piece.

steps.title: Add peas and hold
steps.instruction: Fold in peas, cover 5 minutes, then keep the pot above 140°F if needed.

steps.title: Serve one pot
steps.instruction: Fluff rice gently and serve chicken with the vegetables and tomato-rich rice.

steps.title: Hold for call interruptions
steps.instruction: If tones drop mid-cook: turn off direct heat and cover Chicken thighs — hold at 140°F in a warm cabinet or 200°F oven, never below 140°F for more than 30 minutes cumulative. Log hold time on the pan with a grease pencil. If tones drop after service, cover hot food and keep sides on low heat or ice as appropriate. On return, spot-check proteins at safe internal temp before reopening the line.

steps.title: Pack down leftovers safely
steps.instruction: Cool Chicken thighs and hot components in shallow hotel pans within two hours — deep pots stay in the danger zone too long. Label with date; reheat proteins to 165°F minimum before second shift. Store cold components separately so textures survive overnight.

proTips: Use a wide pot so rice cooks evenly.
If rice is firm, add hot broth and cover again.
Do not stir repeatedly once the pot is covered.
tonightSpread: Condiments: lemon wedges, hot sauce, parsley
Set hot components closest to the crew; cold crunch and toppings at the far end of the line.
Keep a backup tray at 200°F for firefighters returning from a run.
leftovers: Cool Chicken thighs in shallow pans within two hours; label with date and reheat to 165°F before second shift.
Store cold sides separately — hot and cold stacked overnight ruins texture.
whyCrewsLikeIt: It turns basic pantry staples into a complete meal with only one main pan to clean.
mealPrepNotes: Make-ahead: season chicken and chop vegetables 1 day ahead. Storage: refrigerate 3 days. Reheating: heat chicken and rice to 165°F.
substitutions: Use brown rice with extra broth and time.
